questions.q: How does Group Replication decide a transaction is committed, unlike traditional source-replica replication?
options: It broadcasts the transaction to the group and certifies it via a distributed consensus protocol before it counts as committed
It writes to a single binlog file that replicas poll on a schedule
It requires a DBA to manually approve every transaction
It commits locally first and never checks with other members
questions.explain: Group Replication uses certification through XCom, a Paxos-derived protocol, requiring majority agreement before a transaction is considered committed.

options: The Paxos-derived group communication protocol Group Replication's consensus is built on
MySQL Router's internal routing engine
A MySQL Shell command for creating clusters
The storage engine InnoDB Cluster requires
questions.explain: XCom provides the distributed agreement mechanism underlying Group Replication's certification process.

questions.q: In single-primary mode, what happens when the current primary fails?
options: The group's consensus protocol automatically elects a new primary from the remaining members
The entire cluster stops accepting connections permanently
Every remaining member becomes writable simultaneously
A DBA must manually run CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO on every replica
questions.explain: Single-primary mode automatically elects a new primary via the group's own consensus protocol, with no external failover tool required.

questions.q: What does multi-primary mode require that single-primary mode doesn't?
options: The application must be written to detect and retry transactions aborted by certification conflicts
A separate MySQL installation for each primary
Disabling binary logging on all members
Manual GTID assignment for every transaction
questions.explain: Because every member can accept writes, conflicting writes to the same row can cause certification to abort one transaction, which the application must handle.

questions.q: What three components together make up InnoDB Cluster?
options: Group Replication, MySQL Shell's AdminAPI, and MySQL Router
mysqldump, XtraBackup, and the binary log
The source, the replica, and the relay log
STATEMENT, ROW, and MIXED binlog formats
questions.explain: InnoDB Cluster is explicitly three separately named components working together, not a single integrated product.
